breakingChanges.summary: Browser FetchInstrumentation spans must carry full request-context attributes in 0.123 or the collector drops them
breakingChanges.detail: Starting in v0.123.0 the OTLP trace pipeline enforces request/response content correlation. FetchInstrumentation spans that do not carry the full request context are rejected by the collector as non-conformant and are dropped.

migrationSteps.instruction: Add an applyCustomAttributesOnSpan(span, request, result) hook to the FetchInstrumentation configuration that records, on each span: http.request.header.authorization (the request's Authorization header), http.request.body (the serialized request body), and http.response.body (the serialized response body). This is required for v0.123.0 conformance.
